title: NhtEvent
description: NHT (Next Hop Tracking) event for RNH state change notification between FRR and fpmsyncd

rnh_prefix.description: Tracked RNH prefix in addr/len format (e.g. 2064:100::1d/128)

prev_resolved_prefix.description: Previous resolving route prefix in addr/len format. 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 when unresolved

prev_resolved_nhg_id.description: Previous resolving NHG identifier. 0 when unresolved

curr_resolved_prefix.description: Current resolving route prefix in addr/len format. 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 when unresolved

curr_resolved_nhg_id.description: Current resolving NHG identifier. 0 when unresolved
